risks.title: Monitoring plan mistaken for monitoring execution
risks.mitigation: All artifacts set monitoring_execution_started=false. Closeout status is PLAN_READY, not EXECUTED.

risks.title: Candidate review queue mistaken for frozen candidate
risks.mitigation: Queue status is IN_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_QUEUE, not FROZEN. Promotion_allowed=false.
risks.control: Registry and queue matrix both document queue type
risks.rollback_trigger: Factor enters frozen list without human review

risks.title: F26/F27 automatic unlock
risks.control: Hold queue matrix enforces no auto unlock
risks.rollback_trigger: F26/F27 enter approved queue without human decision

risks.title: Monitoring signal mistaken for alpha signal
risks.mitigation: All signal definitions set alpha_claim_allowed=false, execution_allowed=false. Forbidden signal types enforce no alpha/buy/sell.

risks.title: Guardrail monitoring mistaken for guardrail pass
risks.mitigation: Guardrail matrix sets monitoring_type=STALENESS_CHECK, not PASS/FAIL.
risks.rollback_trigger: Guardrail pass status written without execution

risks.title: Stale evidence undetected before candidate review
risks.mitigation: Evidence freshness signal planned for monitoring. Required preconditions include evidence review.
risks.rollback_trigger: evidence more than 30 days stale without review

risks.title: True OOS not completed before promotion
risks.mitigation: required_preconditions include true_oos_required_before_promotion. Guardrail matrix monitors OOS readiness.
risks.control: Precondition check before any promotion gate

risks.title: Family overlap unresolved before promotion
risks.mitigation: Family overlap guardrail monitored. F26/F27 require overlap resolution study before unlock.

risks.title: F27 turnover/cost guardrail not executed before unlock
risks.mitigation: F27 unlock requires turnover_cost_guardrail_execution AND guardrail_pass. Guardrail matrix monitors this.

risks.title: Blocked outputs leak into monitoring plan
risks.mitigation: Signal definitions explicitly exclude alpha/buy/sell/order/position signals. Forbidden signal types documented.
risks.rollback_trigger: Any blocked output type appears in monitoring

risks.title: Z8/V3/BROKER downstream misconnected
risks.mitigation: All signal definitions block Z8, V3, BROKER, REAL_TRADE, PRODUCTION downstream.

risks.title: SkillOS misreads monitoring context as execution context
risks.mitigation: Signal definitions allow SkillOS_readonly_context_future only. execution_allowed=false.
risks.rollback_trigger: SkillOS attempts to execute factor based on monitoring context

risks.title: Paper trading triggered from monitoring plan
Registry status overwritten
risks.mitigation: Registry updates only add monitoring_plan_ref. Do not modify existing frozen/rejected/queue lists.

risks.title: Rejected history (F26/F27 overlap with F05) overwritten
risks.mitigation: Rejected registry read-only for this round. Overlap referenced but not modified.

risks.title: V13_6 execution triggered instead of monitoring
risks.mitigation: v13_6_allowed=false across all artifacts. Monitoring plan is not an execution pipeline.
